title: Courses
text: Wyatt Education Group offers nationally recognised qualifications including the Diploma of Business and the Advanced Diploma of Leadership and Management. Enrolment is open to domestic and international students.

title: Certificate III in Wall and Floor Tiling
text: The Certificate III in Wall and Floor Tiling is delivered at the Lidcombe workshop facility in the Sydney metro area. The total course fee is $10,500 for international students and $6,500 for domestic students.
